mask_convention: L PNG, 0 transparent/255 occluding. Selectors are binary item-part selectors; occluders are body alpha at that pose. Body-core/right-hand/head-foreground are disjoint RGBA layers: do not also draw base-without-weapon or apply the occluder a second time.
body_occlusion: Rear items are naturally occluded by the disjoint body parts; front weapons are occluded by the original right hand. Crown/near brim are front; far brim is rear. Original face/nape pixels are drawn once on top.
scope: Idle only. No walking/attack transfer. New poses require individually painted equipment, anchors and occlusion review; no automatic hand swapping or horizontal flips.
